V3 更新提示词：

移除图1人物的头发、耳环、项链、帽子等头部配饰；

将图1人物的脸替换为图2人物的脸（完全覆盖原图人脸，无残留）；

将图1人物的发型替换为图2人物的发型：（长短、颜色与图2完全一致，无原图发型残留）；

同步替换为图2人物的表情（眼神、脸部朝向与图2一致）；

新脸、新发型需适配图1场景光影，自然融合，过渡无痕迹。


V2：

用更多的图集重新训练，包括了中国人和西方人以及不同性别

更多的训练步数

请确保图2中的人物的头部脸没有遮挡且完整清楚（Please ensure that the head and face of the character in Figure 2 are unobstructed and complete and clear）

测试环境参数：（Test environment parameters:）

qwen2509fp8 + 8 step lighting lora + 12 steps +cfg1 + euler +beta

仍存的在问题：

大多数时候脸部会变替换（Most of the time, the face will be replaced）

有些时候发型不能完整的替换 留给V3解决（Sometimes the hairstyle cannot be completely replaced and left to V3 to solve）
头或许变大,或许重要的话可以用ps液化调整一下（ bigger head ,also can photoshop it if important ）

可以换头或只换脸，下面是示例指令(中英文选其一即可)

You can change your head or just your face. Here are example instructions (choose one in Chinese or English，but Prioritize using Chinese because this is a large Chinese model)

简单指令：(Simple prompt)

不改变图1的背景和人物姿势，把图1中的人物的头换成图2中人物的头,要把图2人物的脸，头发和饰品都换到图1中现在人物的头部位置，替换后尽量保持图2人物的脸部特征和发型不变，并且融合图1环境的光影。

Without changing the background and posture of the character in image1, replace the head of the character in image1 with the head of the character in image2. The face, hair, and accessories of the character in image2 should be moved to the current position of the character's head in image1. After replacement, try to keep the facial features and hairstyle of the character in image2 unchanged, and integrate the light and shadow of the environment in image1.

以下是优化后的参考指令（可跟据每条修改）：(The following are optimized reference instructions (can be modified according to each one):)

换头全换指令：(Head replacement instruction:)

去掉图1中人物的头发、耳环(如果有)、项链(如果有),去掉图1中人物的帽子(如果有)。

把图1中的人物的脸换成图2中人物的脸。

把图1中人物的发型换成图2中人物的发型，长短和颜色与图2中的人物一致。

把图1中人物的表情换成图2中人物的表情，眼神和脸的方向均与图2中的人物一致。

检查最终效果的人物的脸要变成图2中人物的脸，不要再保留图1中的人物的脸。

检查最终效果的人物的发型要变成图2中人物的发型，不要在保留图1的人物的发型。

融合图1环境的光影

Remove the hair, earrings (if any), necklace (if any), and hat (if any) of the character in Figure 1.

Replace the face of the character in Figure 1 with the face of the character in Figure 2.

Replace the hairstyle of the character in Figure 1 with the hairstyle of the character in Figure 2, with the same length and color as the character in Figure 2.

Replace the facial expressions of the characters in Figure 1 with those in Figure 2, with eye contact and face orientation consistent with those of the characters in Figure 2.

The face of the character in the final effect should be changed to the face of the character in Figure 2, and the face of the character in Figure 1 should no longer be retained.

The hairstyle of the character checking the final effect should be changed to the hairstyle of the character in Figure 2, rather than retaining the hairstyle of the character in Figure 1.

Integrating the light and shadow of the environment in image1

只换脸指令：

把图1中的人物的脸换成图2中人物的脸。

保持图1中人物的发型和颜色，不要换成图2中人物的发型和颜色

把图1中人物的表情换成图2中人物的表情，眼神和脸的方向均与图2中的人物一致。

检查最终效果的人物的脸要变成图2中人物的脸，不要再保留图1中的人物的脸。

检查最终效果的人物的发型和颜色仍是原图1中人物的发型，不要变成图2中的人物的发型和颜色。

Only face changing instruction:

Replace the face of the character in Figure 1 with the face of the character in Figure 2.

Maintain the hairstyle and color of the character in Figure 1, and do not switch to the hairstyle and color of the character in Figure 2

Replace the facial expressions of the characters in Figure 1 with those in Figure 2, with eye contact and face orientation consistent with those of the characters in Figure 2.

The face of the character in the final effect should be changed to the face of the character in Figure 2, and the face of the character in Figure 1 should no longer be retained.

Check that the hairstyle and color of the character in the final effect are still the same as those in Figure 1, and do not change to the hairstyle and color of the character in Figure 2.

--

当然更多玩法可以自己去体验一下，比如表情保留图1还是换成图2，跟据需要参考指令试一下吧

Of course, you can experience more gameplay by yourself, such as whether to keep the emoji in Figure 1 or switch it to Figure 2. Please refer to the instructions as needed and try it out
